name: Influenza, COVID-19, and RSV Intensive Care Unit Admissions

columns.name: disease
columns.description: The reportable respiratory disease (e.g. Influenza, RSV, COVID-19)

columns.name: mmwr_week
columns.description: A weekly counting system within a calendar year standardized by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

columns.name: week
columns.description: The calendar week standardized by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

columns.name: week_start
columns.description: Beginning date of the MMWR week

columns.name: week_end
columns.description: Ending date of the MMWR week

columns.name: season
columns.description: Annually recurring reporting period for which estimates are calculated, beginning during MMWR week 40 and ending with week 39 of the following year

columns.name: characteristic_category
columns.description: Overall category of demographic group (e.g., Age Group, Race/Ethnicity).

columns.name: characteristic_group
columns.description: Specific demographic group (e.g., 0-4, 65+, Latinx). This is a subset of the characteristic category.

columns.name: count
columns.description: Total number of ICU admissions for the specified disease and for the specified characteristic group .

columns.name: count_pct
columns.description: Percentage of ICU admissions for the specified disease and for the specified characteristic group. Note: Characteristic group ‘All Cases’ will always be 100%.

columns.name: count_cumulative
columns.description: Total number of ICU admissions for the specified disease and for the specified characteristic group in the specified season, which goes from week 40 of each year to week 39 of the following year.

columns.name: count_pct_cumulative
columns.description: Percentage of ICU admissions for the specified disease and for the specified characteristic group in the specified season, which goes from week 40 of each year to week 39 of the following year.

columns.name: rate_cumulative
columns.description: The cumulative incidence rate for the specified disease and for the specified characteristic group in the specified season, which goes from week 40 of each year to week 39 of the following year.

columns.name: current_week_ending
columns.description: Ending date of the MMWR week for the current season

columns.name: row_id
columns.description: A unique ID for the row
